options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: mission_reward_multiplier
options.description:
How many item checks each mission/arena/rank objective awards.
At 4x the seed uses nearly the entire part catalogue, leaving little
variety between seeds. Lower values give more rotation per seed.

options.name: run_mode
options.description:
How many New Game cycles the run spans, and whether each cycle has its
own set of checks.

single:             one playthrough, any ending completes the goal.

options.name: shop_checks
options.description:
Add shop purchases as check locations. Shop slots absorb any remaining
parts after mission/arena/rank locations are filled, up to 300 slots
across 4 chapters. Slot mapping is sent via slot_data; no per-seed files
are needed. Shop checks are cycle-agnostic and fire exactly once.

options.name: mercenary_rank_checks
options.description:
How many mercenary rank checks to include (0-17).
Order: 1 -> 2 -> ... -> 17. Set to 0 to disable.

options.name: arena_checks
options.description:
How many arena checks to include (0-10).
Order: 1=F -> 2=E -> 3=D -> 4=C -> 5=B -> 6=A -> 7=S -> 8=Alpha Simulator -> 9=Beta Simulator -> 10=Gamma Simulator
Set to 0 to disable.

options.name: local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: non_local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

options.name: start_inventory
options.description: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: "Bomb: 1"

options.name: start_hints
options.description: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

options.name: start_location_hints
options.description: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
